response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district.district_id, district.A3 AS region, COUNT(disp.disp_id) AS client_count FROM district LEFT JOIN account ON account.district_id = district.district_id LEFT JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id GROUP BY district.district_id, district.A3), totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_total, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_total FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(region_total, 0) AS region_share, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(overall_total, 0) AS overall_share FROM totals ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id LIMIT 10;
